notes:
Technical description of the accepted tree; it sets no deployment policy. Supply, allocations, owners and chain come from the launch policy.

TOKEN: OrbitalToken (src/OrbitalToken.sol), self-contained ERC-20, name Orbital, symbol ORB, 18 decimals. Zero-argument constructor mints exactly 1,000,000,000 ORB (10^27 minor units) once to msg.sender. No owner, mint, burn, pause, blocklist, fee, proxy or selfdestruct. ORB is not a basket coin: any ORB pool under the hook is pass-through, with the pause as its only hook behaviour.

HOOK: OrbitalHook (src/OrbitalHook.sol) on the repo's own BaseHook; solc 0.8.26, cancun, optimizer 200 runs, no via_ir, bytecode_hash none. getHookPermissions returns exactly beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap and beforeSwapReturnDelta (address flags 0x2888 = 10376); afterInitialize and the other nine flags are false. Every callback is PoolManager-only; unimplemented ones revert. beforeInitialize reverts IsPaused while paused, registers the pool as an Orbital pair when both currencies are basket coins, otherwise leaves it pass-through, and returns its selector. beforeAddLiquidity reverts LiquidityLivesInHook on Orbital pairs only. beforeSwap reverts IsPaused on every pool while paused; on Orbital pairs it prices the whole specified amount on the N-sphere (Paradigm Orbital; fee feePpm on input; reserves held as ERC-6909 claims) and returns a BeforeSwapDelta; pass-through pools use v4's own curve. Owner may pause, unpause, setGuardian, setFee (max 10,000 ppm) and transferOwnership; guardian may only guardianPause. Nobody can move LP funds; withdrawals work while paused. Breaker: OrbitalDepegReactive (Reactive Lasna) watches a Chainlink AnswerUpdated feed and sends a Callback to Unichain Sepolia (1301), where the Reactive proxy invokes OrbitalDepegCallback, set as guardian by the owner after deployment. Neither breaker contract is in this manifest.

CONSTRUCTOR, declaration order: (IPoolManager, address owner, address guardian, address[] basket, uint8[] decimals, uint256[] kNorms, uint24 feePpm). Argument 0 is $poolManager. Argument 2 (guardian) is legitimately zero: the callback needs the hook address, so it is wired later by setGuardian. Argument 6 is 400 (0.04%). The constructor makes no external calls and requires owner nonzero, 2..8 distinct nonzero basket tokens with decimals <= 18, 1..8 ascending kNorms in (sqrtN-1, (N-1)/sqrtN], fee <= 1%.

BLOCKING GAP, NOT RESOLVABLE IN THIS MANIFEST (finding 927b219e, re-verified): a univ4_hook manifest carries only $poolManager, a literal address or an integer per argument, and no $owner. Arguments 3-5 are dynamic arrays and cannot be expressed; the 0 written there is a placeholder no ABI encoder accepts, so the deployer fails safely. Argument 1 is zero because no policy owner is available here; the constructor reverts ZeroAddress, so the protected Hook floor reports 'hook deployment reverted'. Reproduced: CREATE2 with (poolManager, 0, 0, [], [], [], 400) at a 0x2888 salt returns address(0); a nonzero owner with empty arrays reverts InvalidTokens; a 3-coin control basket deploys. Hold at admission until either (a) a hook implement task revises src/OrbitalHook.sol so the constructor takes only (IPoolManager, uint24 feePpm) and basket, decimals and kNorms are set once by an owner-only lockable configure call, the owner supplied from policy; or (b) the deployer adds array arguments and an $owner placeholder and this manifest is rewritten. Intended: owner = policy owner; basket incl. Circle USDC on Unichain Sepolia 0x31d0220469e10c4E71834a79b1f276d740d3768F (6 decimals); kNorms per README.

POOL: currency0 native ETH (zero address), currency1 ORB, static LP fee 3000 (0.3%), tickSpacing 60: a pass-through pool. initialPrice 79228162514264337593543950336 is 2^96 (1 ORB per ETH, tick 0); the hook constrains neither price nor fee. The hook address is CREATE2-mined for flags 0x2888.

Local checks: forge build and forge test (85 tests, incl. fuzz) pass.
